units: <cite ref="Berakhot 7a:3">Ber. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>שיכבשו רַחֲמַי את כעסי וכ׳</he> that my mercy may conquer my anger &c., v. <cite ref="C00959"><he>גָּלַל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 7a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>שיכבשו רַחֲמֶיךָ וכ׳</he> that thy mercy &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 10a:2">Ib. 10ᵃ</cite>, sq. <he>אל ימנע עצמו מן הר׳</he> must not despair of mercy (cease to pray), v. <cite ref="M01800"><he>מָנַע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 55a:9">Ib. 55ᵃ</cite> <he>שלשה צריכים ר׳</he> three things must be prayed for.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 2:12">Lev. R. s. 2</cite>, end <he>הריני עמו בר׳ וכ׳</he> I shall be in grace with him, and he will receive me in repentance.
Num. R. s. 20, beg. כל הנביאים היו במדת ר׳ על וכ׳ all the (Israelitish) prophets were benevolently disposed towards Israel and towards the nations; a. v. fr.—בקש ר׳ to ask for mercy, to pray.
<cite ref="Makkot 11a:17">Macc. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>שהיה להן לבקש ר׳ על וכ׳</he> it was their duty to pray for their generation &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 67a:16">Sabb. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>ורבים יבקשו עליו ר׳</he> and the people will pray for him.

<cite ref="Shabbat 151b:13">Ib. 151ᵇ</cite> <he>לעולם … ר׳ על מידה זו וכ׳</he> man must always pray concerning this condition (poverty), for if he does not come to it, his son will &c.; a. fr., v. <cite ref="B01148"><he>בָּקַשׁ</he></cite>.—<he>מדת הר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D00635"><he>דִּין</he> II</cite>. <he>כסא ר׳</he>, v. <cite ref="K00893"><he>כִּסֵּא</he></cite>.
